headline: Emory & Henry overtake Catawba at the top
dek: Coker ended Catawba's unbeaten season with a win at Catawba on Wednesday, while Emory & Henry beat Tusculum to go a point clear. They are now the only side in the conference without a defeat.
displaced_by: Coker beat Catawba and Emory & Henry went top: the standing lede's leader, its two-point margin and 'neither side has lost' are no longer true.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Emory & Henry have scored 23 and conceded four: the side now top of the table has got there by keeping goals out, not by scoring them.

wire.line: Catawba's first defeat, at home to Coker, has handed Emory & Henry the top of the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Palm Beach Atlantic in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coker's win at Catawba on Wednesday was their seventh of the season, against one draw and five defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mars Hill's win over Lenoir-Rhyne on Wednesday was their eighth of the season, against three draws and six defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate's win over Newberry on Wednesday was their sixth of the season, against two draws and seven defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Carson-Newman's home draw with Lincoln Memorial on Wednesday was their third of the season, beside seven wins and five defeats.

last_match.line: Catawba had not lost all season until this; Emory & Henry are now the conference's only unbeaten side.

next_match.line: Catawba beat Mars Hill on the same ground in September; Mars Hill have outscored every other side in the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
